==Description==
To be placed before sections of articles that describe optional [[roleplaying game]] adventure seeds or suggestions.

==Usage==
Place <code><nowiki>{{RPGseed}}</nowiki></code> before the section describing the suggestion, and place <code>{{Tl|Endgame}}</code> after the section.
